title: Tech Note: Connected Multimedia Apps with 4D and Flash

historical_commentary.text: This note showcases pairing a 4th Dimension backend with a Macromedia Flash front-end, a popular rich-client web technique in the mid-2000s that was demonstrated at the 2003 4D Summit Conference. Flash itself was deprecated and discontinued by Adobe in 2020, making the specific client technology and integration approach entirely obsolete, though the broader idea of a 4D backend powering a rich, interactive front-end client remains conceptually alive today via modern web/mobile frameworks and 4D's own web area / 4D Mobile-era tooling.
related_updates: Adobe officially discontinued Flash Player at the end of 2020, and modern browsers no longer support it, making Flash-based front-ends non-functional today
Rich client/backend integration patterns similar in spirit are now built with modern web frameworks (e.g., via 4D's Web Area/QML or REST/JSON APIs) rather than Flash
